ability.name: Master of Temptation
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, while your opponent has not used any of their temptation dice to replace a roll for the target this turn, the target can only use **^^Core^^** abilities.
ability.declare: You can only use this ability if your opponent has any temptation dice. Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.

ability.name: Celebrity Warlord
ability.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^Hero Sybarite^^** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

ability.name: The Need For Perfection
ability.effect: The first time each turn that an unmodified charge roll, casting roll, unbinding roll or banishment roll for a friendly non-**^^Euphoric^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit is 5 or less, that unit has the **^^Euphoric^^** keyword for the rest of the turn.
